method: Fresh unaudited mechanics frontier after excluding the live Batch 436 selection and prior current-evidence audit records; four shortest remaining active mechanics tiers were researched and synchronized.
findings: Majin Kamehameha: current exact-name evidence corrects the stale Ultimate classification to Super and confirms 100 Ki, PQ60, three charge stages, 5-to-15 hits, approximately 10%-to-15% source-reported damage, and Majin-only CaC use.
Mach Dash: current evidence confirms 200 Stamina, Power Up Evasive classification, PQ18, 1.5% speed increase, and a documented 11.5-vs-12-second duration discrepancy.
Revenge Death Ball: current evidence expands the resource model to 300+ Ki, 12-to-22 hits, approximately 30%-to-70% source-reported damage, 300 Ki consumed on input, and remaining-Ki charge behavior.

Namek Finger: current evidence confirms 100 Ki, Namekian-only CaC use, grab/stun behavior, documented 10% damage, and the distinction between generic current Skill Shop labeling and maintained TP Medal Shop provenance.
